rules.title: Svelte 5 runes
rules.text: Use Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $props, $effect) and avoid legacy reactive statements.

rules.title: Prefer $derived over $effect
rules.text: Use $derived for computed values and reserve $effect for side effects.

rules.title: Load data in load functions
rules.text: Fetch page data in SvelteKit load functions, not in component onMount.

rules.title: TypeScript in components
rules.text: Use lang="ts" in components and type $props explicitly.

rules.title: Fix Svelte a11y warnings
rules.text: Treat Svelte accessibility warnings as errors and fix them.
